question: Should Control UI expose a globally persisted manual chat-composer height, rather than keeping composer sizing fully automatic or scoped per chat session?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing preference with intentional cross-session behavior; code review cannot determine the desired long-term product scope.

options.title: Approve global preference
options.body: Accept one browser-local height shared by Control UI chat sessions and proceed after the branch is rebased.

options.title: Scope it per session
options.body: Require the implementation to attach the height to individual chat sessions if independent composer layouts are the desired experience.

options.title: Keep autosizing only
options.body: Decline the new preference and retain the existing capped automatic composer sizing.

recommendation.title: Approve global preference
recommendation.body: Accept one browser-local height shared by Control UI chat sessions and proceed after the branch is rebased.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires product acceptance of a persistent Control UI behavior rather than a mechanical code repair.
